name: 回溯
description: 秘密选择1～10次。对方下回合第N次移动或使用技能后，或其回合结束时，将自身位置、生命、护盾和状态还原至施放时。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var result = Number(context.selectedOption); if (!Number.isInteger(result) || result < 1 || result > 10) { return { success: false, message: 'Invalid Recall action count' }; } if (!battle.extensions) { battle.extensions = {}; } if (!battle.extensions.recallData) { battle.extensions.recallData = []; } var data = battle.extensions.recallData; data = data.filter(function(r) { return r.pieceId !== caster.instanceId; }); data.push({ pieceId: caster.instanceId, ownerPlayerId: caster.ownerPlayerId, projectionVisibility: 'owner', targetCount: result, actionCount: 0, snapshot: { x: caster.x, y: caster.y, hp: caster.currentHp, shield: caster.shield, statusTags: caster.statusTags ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(caster.statusTags)) : [], buffs: caster.buffs ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(caster.buffs)) : [], debuffs: caster.debuffs ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(caster.debuffs)) : [] } }); battle.extensions.recallData = data; return { success: true, message: caster.name + '已设置回溯' }; }
